mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, cycle_type, cycle_no, total_tokens, used_tokens, reserved_tokens, unlimited, warning_threshold, cycle_start, cycle_end, status, version, remark, create_dept, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time FROM user_token_account WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND cycle_no = #{cycleNo} ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 1
